gloss: to be stubborn; to dig in one's heels

definitions.gloss: to be stubborn; to dig in one's heels; to insist obstinately
definitions.explanation: To stubbornly hold to one's position or pride, refusing to yield or compromise even when it would be reasonable to do so. Often implies the person knows they should back down but won't.

examples.japanese: ⟦そんな→そんな：01645_sonna⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{意地|いじ}を{張|は}らないで。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{間違|まちが}っていて→間違う：03036_machigau⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{意地|いじ}を{張|は}る。
examples.english: He digs in his heels even when he's wrong.

examples.japanese: {意地|いじ}を{張|は}って⟦{謝|あやま}らなかった→謝る：01177_ayamaru⟧こと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{後悔|こうかい}→後悔：02738_koukai⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I regret being too stubborn to apologize.

notes:
USAGE:
The verb ⟦{張|は}る→張る：12583_haru⟧ conjugates normally as a godan verb. The expression carries a negative connotation — it implies stubbornness that is counterproductive or excessive.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {意地|いじ}を{張|は}らないで (don't be stubborn)
- {意地|いじ}を{張|は}って～⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (stubbornly do something)
- {意地|いじ}を{張|は}って～⟦しない→する：00392_suru⟧ (stubbornly refuse to do something)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{意地|いじ}っ{張|ぱ}り→意地っ張り：18869_ijippari⟧ (stubborn person; stubbornness)
- ⟦{頑固|がんこ}→頑固：06643_ganko⟧ (obstinate — describes a personality trait, while {意地|いじ}を{張|は}る describes a deliberate action)
